# orq_mcp_server (Resource)

An upstream MCP server registered in the workspace. Creating a server does not sync its tools: a gateway can only link an `HTTP` or `SSE` server after its tools were synced once (in the orq UI or through the sync API). `OPENAPI` servers compile their tools on create. Changing `upstream` or `auth` makes orq dial the upstream and rejects the update when it is unreachable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "docs_mcp_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# A remote MCP server authenticated with a static header. The header values are
# write-only: orq never returns them, so they live only in state.
resource "orq_mcp_server" "docs" {
  key          = "docs"
  display_name = "Docs MCP"
  description  = "Search and read the product documentation"

  upstream = {
    type = "HTTP" # HTTP | SSE | OPENAPI
    url  = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
  }

  auth = {
    type = "STATIC_HEADERS"
    static_headers = {
      Authorization = "Bearer ${var.docs_mcp_token}"
    }
  }

  # Fallback for gateway links that do not narrow the tool surface themselves.
  default_tool_exposure = {
    mode      = "ALL" # ALL | SELECTED | NONE
    read_only = true
  }

  sharing = {
    all_projects = true
  }
}

# OAuth client credentials — set `oauth` instead of `static_headers`:
#
# resource "orq_mcp_server" "crm" {
#   key          = "crm"
#   display_name = "CRM MCP"
#
#   upstream = {
#     type = "HTTP"
#     url  = "https://crm.example.com/mcp"
#   }
#
#   auth = {
#     type = "OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS"
#     oauth = {
#       client_id     = "orq-gateway"
#       client_secret = var.crm_client_secret
#       token_url     = "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"
#       scopes        = ["crm.read"]
#     }
#   }
#
#   default_tool_exposure = {
#     mode = "ALL"
#   }
# }

# An OpenAPI document served as MCP tools; `upstream.url` is the API base URL.
#
# resource "orq_mcp_server" "petstore" {
#   key          = "petstore"
#   display_name = "Petstore API"
#
#   upstream = {
#     type = "OPENAPI"
#     url  = "https://petstore.example.com/v1"
#   }
#
#   auth = {
#     type = "NONE"
#   }
#
#   openapi = {
#     document_url = "https://petstore.example.com/openapi.json"
#     operations   = ["listPets", "getPetById"]
#   }
#
#   default_tool_exposure = {
#     mode = "ALL"
#   }
# }
```

## Schema

### Required

- `auth` (Attributes) Credentials orq sends upstream. Use `type = "NONE"` for public servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `default_tool_exposure` (Attributes) Fallback exposure used by any gateway link that does not set its own. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_tool_exposure))
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `key` (String) Lowercase slug (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores; max 64), unique per workspace. Prefixes this server's tool names in gateways. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.
- `upstream` (Attributes) How orq dials the upstream server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upstream))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form note about what this server is for.
- `openapi` (Attributes) Source of the tools of an `OPENAPI` server; set `document` or `document_url`. Changing it recompiles the tools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openapi))
- `sharing` (Attributes) Which projects may use this server. Exactly one of `all_projects` or `project_ids` must be set. Omitted shares with every project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sharing))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) MCP server ID assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Required:

- `type` (String) `NONE`, `STATIC_HEADERS`, `OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS`, `PER_USER_OAUTH` or `ENTERPRISE_MANAGED` (requires Cross App Access on the workspace's SSO configuration).

Optional:

- `oauth` (Attributes) OAuth client presented to the upstream authorization server, for the OAuth auth types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--oauth))
- `static_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent upstream on every request, by header name; required when `type` is `STATIC_HEADERS`. Write-only: orq never returns the values, so the provider keeps the configured ones in state and cannot detect out-of-band changes.

<a id="nestedatt--auth--oauth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.oauth`

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client identifier.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. Write-only: orq never returns it, so the provider keeps the configured value in state.
- `issuer` (String) Exact authorization-server issuer; pins discovery for `PER_USER_OAUTH` and `ENTERPRISE_MANAGED`.
- `resource` (String) Protected resource identifier. Omitted uses the upstream URL.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes requested when minting upstream access tokens.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint; only for `OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS`.



<a id="nestedatt--default_tool_exposure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_tool_exposure`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Selection strategy: `ALL`, `SELECTED` or `NONE`.

Optional:

- `excluded_tool_ids` (List of String) Tool ids deliberately left unexposed when `mode` is `SELECTED`.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Keep only the tools the upstream annotates as read-only. Defaults to `false`.
- `tool_ids` (List of String) Tool ids to expose when `mode` is `SELECTED`. Ids are assigned by orq when the server's tools are synced.


<a id="nestedatt--upstream"></a>
### Nested Schema for `upstream`

Required:

- `type` (String) Transport: `HTTP`, `SSE` or `OPENAPI` (tools are the operations of an OpenAPI document and `url` is the API base URL). Switching to or from `OPENAPI` forces replacement.
- `url` (String) Upstream endpoint (http or https).


<a id="nestedatt--openapi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `openapi`

Optional:

- `document` (String) OpenAPI 3.x document as JSON or YAML. Write-only: orq compiles it and never returns it, so the provider keeps the configured value in state.
- `document_url` (String) URL the OpenAPI document is fetched from.
- `operations` (List of String) Tool names of the operations to expose. Omitted exposes every operation.


<a id="nestedatt--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sharing`

Optional:

- `all_projects` (Boolean) Share with every project in the workspace. Only accepts `true`. Mutually exclusive with `project_ids`.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Share with exactly these projects; an empty list shares with no project. Mutually exclusive with `all_projects`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# MCP servers are imported by their id or their workspace-unique key.
terraform import orq_mcp_server.example docs
```
